svg.title: Five original workshop companions, animated with real production choreographies
svg.desc: Offline production-renderer recording of fixed synthetic sessions. Folio reads, Ink codes, Moss tests, Thread builds, Glow waits for user input. A smaller Thread helper belongs to the same family. No private session data, no fabricated success, no network resources. Reduced-motion preference shows a static frame.
svg.text: 五种材质 · 一个小小工坊 / Five materials, one little workshop
